objective: Repair the five public-bar-only family proof-basis gaps without inventing five duplicate empirical programs. A broad family may close by exact clause coverage: benchmark-owner-described public core plus already-declared family proofs plus the existing composition proof for cross-family interaction.

theorem.name: CLAUSEWISE_DEPENDENCY_CLOSURE
theorem.statement: Let the declared useful behavior of family F be partitioned into explicit semantic clauses. Each clause must be bound to exactly one admissible authority class: PUBLIC_CORE, EXISTING_FAMILY_PROOF, or INTERACTION_PROOF. PUBLIC_CORE covers only behavior explicitly supported by benchmark-owner/target documentation. EXISTING_FAMILY_PROOF closes only when that family's scoped proof closes. INTERACTION_PROOF closes only when MULTI_CAPABILITY_COMPOSITION closes for the relevant interaction. If every declared clause is covered and every bound authority passes, no additional family-specific empirical scope audit is logically required.
